Different from other differential abundance tools, low prevalence features need not be filtered out since the prevalence modeling in MaAsLin 3 already accounts for high proportions of zeros. However, filtering low prevalence features might improve power.

There are also a few rules of thumb to keep in mind.

- Models should ideally have about 10 times as many samples (all samples for logistic fits, non-zero samples for linear fits) as covariate terms (all continuous variables plus all categorical variable levels).

- Coefficients (effect sizes) larger than about 15 in absolute value are usually suspect unless very small unstandardized predictors are being included. (A coefficient of 15 corresponds to a fold change \>30000!). If you encounter such coefficients, check that (1) no error was thrown, (2) the diagnostics look reasonable, (3) a sufficient number of samples were used in fitting, (4) the q-value is significant, (5) the metadata are not highly collinear, and (6) the random effects are plausible.

Maaslin3 Model Selection Strategy\
In Maaslin3, you specify:

- `fixed_effects`: variables you want to test or control for

- `random_effects`: grouping variables to account for non-independence (e.g., repeated measures)

Based on this, I selected site (city: WAT, KIT, CAL, HESP) as random factors. However, we only have 4 levels in site, therefore I will try and run it with small_random_effects=TRUE, as otherwise the model may be too unstable. Another alternative would be to run all as fixed levels.

## Loading Data

Loading the phyloseq objects

```{r Loading-data-maaslin3}
#not rarefied dataset "ps_final"
load("R_output/ps_objects/GrandRiverMB_phyloseq_filt_unnorm.RData")

```

Create output directory

```{r create-maaslin3-output-dir}
# Create output directory
output_dir <- file.path("R_output", "MaAsLin3_Genus")

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  message("Output directory created: ", output_dir)
} else {
  message("Output directory already exists: ", output_dir)
}
```

#### Prepare data for analysis

```{r prep-data-for-maaslin3}
#Prepare data for analysis
#Extract abundance (e.g., genus level) Species recommended
ps<- tax_glom(ps_final, taxrank = "Genus")

otu <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps))  # Features
if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) {
  otu <- t(otu)
}
 
otu <- as.data.frame(otu)
otu <- otu[, sapply(otu, is.numeric)]

#metadata
meta <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame")

sapply(meta[, c("Location", "Site")], class)
str(meta[, c("Location", "Site")])

meta$Location <- factor(meta$Location,
                               levels = c("UP", "DWN"))

# dropping rows not shared between OTU and meta
shared_ids <- intersect(rownames(otu), rownames(meta))
otu <- otu[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]
meta <- meta[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]

# Sort to make sure sample order matches
otu <- otu[order(rownames(otu)), ]
meta <- meta[order(rownames(meta)), ]

# Extract taxonomy table from phyloseq
tax_table_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps))

# Make sure rownames are ASV IDs (should be already)
taxonomy_df <- tax_table_df

# Optional: check taxonomy columns
head(taxonomy_df)

# Add read depth
meta$read_depth <- sample_sums(ps)

# scale to thousands for interpretability
meta$read_depth_k <- meta$read_depth / 1000

#check
meta$read_depth
```

```{r rename-otu-table-to-include-species-names}

# replace spaces or NAs if present
taxonomy_df$Genus[is.na(taxonomy_df$Genus)] <- "Unknown"
taxonomy_df$Genus <- gsub(" ", "_", taxonomy_df$Genus)

# Assign ASV names (rownames in taxonomy_df) to this new column for easy matching
name_map <- taxonomy_df$Genus
names(name_map) <- rownames(taxonomy_df)

# Rename OTU table columns using the name map, but only where there is a match
colnames(otu) <- ifelse(colnames(otu) %in% names(name_map),
                        name_map[colnames(otu)],
                        colnames(otu))  # leave unmatched ASVs as-is
otu
```

```{r prevalence-filter}
#taxa present in at least x% samples
prevalence_threshold <- 0.05
prevalent_taxa <- colnames(otu)[colSums(otu > 0) >= prevalence_threshold * nrow(otu)]
otu_filtered <- otu[, prevalent_taxa]

cat("Prevalence filter",prevalence_threshold, ": Kept", length(prevalent_taxa), "taxa out of", ncol(otu), "\n")
```

## MaAsLin3 full community model

runnin full community meaning no separation before analysis. Spiders are run separately as they don't have different lifestages.

```{r maaslin3-full-community-model}
# Subset to samples with Lifestage 
meta_full <- meta 

# Ensure factors
meta_full$Site <- factor(meta_full$Site)
meta_full$Location <- factor(meta_full$Location)
meta_full$Lifestage <- factor(meta_full$Lifestage)
meta_full$Taxa <- factor(meta_full$Taxa)

# Subset OTU to matching samples
otu_full <- otu_filtered[rownames(meta_full), , drop = FALSE]

# Ensure same order
otu_full <- otu_full[order(rownames(otu_full)), ]
meta_full <- meta_full[order(rownames(meta_full)), ]

stopifnot(identical(rownames(otu_full), rownames(meta_full)))

# Create output folder
output_full <- file.path(output_dir, "MaAsLin3_Full_Model")

# Remove the existing output folder if it exists
if (dir.exists(output_full)) {
    message("Cleaning output directory: ", output_full)
    success <- unlink(output_full, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
    if (success == 0) {
      message("Successfully removed: ", output_full)
    } else {
      warning("Failed to remove: ", output_full)
    }
}

# Recreate the output folder cleanly
dir.create(output_full, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
message("Output directory created: ", output_full)

# Run MaAsLin3
fit_full <- maaslin3(
  input_data = otu_full,
  input_metadata = meta_full,
  output = output_full,
  formula = "~ Location + Taxa+ Lifestage + read_depth + (1 | Site)",
  normalization = "TSS",
  transform = "LOG",
  correction = "BH",
  summary_plot_first_n = 25,
  standardize = TRUE,
  small_random_effects = TRUE,
  max_significance = 0.1 # optional for exploratory inclusiveness
)
```

## MaAsLin3 by taxon

fixed effects: Location, Lifestage (for macroinverts only), sequencing_depth

random effects: Site (small_random_effects=TRUE)

```{r maaslin3-by-taxon}

# Customize this as needed
taxa_list <- unique(meta$Taxa)

output_base <- file.path(output_dir, "MaAsLin3_by_taxon")

# Remove the existing output folder if it exists
if (dir.exists(output_base)) {
    message("Cleaning output directory: ", output_base)
    success <- unlink(output_base, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
    if (success == 0) {
      message("Successfully removed: ", output_base)
    } else {
      warning("Failed to remove: ", output_base)
    }
}

# Recreate the output folder cleanly
dir.create(output_base, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
message("Output directory created: ", output_base)


# Loop over each taxon
for (taxon in unique(meta$Taxa)) {
  message("Processing: ", taxon)

  # Subset metadata
  meta_sub <- subset(meta, Taxa == taxon)
  
  # Convert fixed effects to factors
meta_sub$Site <- factor(meta_sub$Site)
meta_sub$Location <- factor(meta_sub$Location)
meta_sub$Lifestage <- factor(meta_sub$Lifestage)
  
  # Skip if too few samples
  if (nrow(meta_sub) < 10) {
    message("  Skipping (too few samples)")
    next
  }

  # Skip if not both life stages
  if (length(unique(meta_sub$Lifestage)) < 2) {
    message("  Skipping (not both life stages)")
    next
  }

  # Subset OTU
  otu_sub <- otu_filtered[rownames(meta_sub), , drop = FALSE]

  # Drop features with no variance
  otu_sub <- otu_sub[, apply(otu_sub, 2, var) > 0]

  # Match sample order
  meta_sub <- meta_sub[order(rownames(meta_sub)), ]
  otu_sub <- otu_sub[order(rownames(otu_sub)), ]
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(meta_sub), rownames(otu_sub)))

  # Define output directory for taxon
  output_dir_tax <- file.path(output_base, paste0("Taxon_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", taxon)))
  dir.create(output_dir_tax, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # Run MaAsLin3
  fit_data <-maaslin3(
    input_data = otu_sub,
    input_metadata = meta_sub,
    output = output_dir_tax,
    formula = "~ Location + Lifestage + read_depth + (1 | Site)",
    normalization = "TSS",
    transform = "LOG",
    correction = "BH",
    summary_plot_first_n = 25,
    standardize = T,
     small_random_effects=TRUE
  )
}
```

## MaAsLin3 by Lifestage

fixed effects: Location, sequencing depth

random effects: Site (can only use on random factor)

small_random_effects=TRUE

```{r maaslin3-by-lifestage}
# Customize this as needed
lifestage_list <- unique(meta$Lifestage)

output_base <- file.path(output_dir, "MaAsLin3_by_Lifestage")

# Remove the existing output folder if it exists
if (dir.exists(output_base)) {
    message("Cleaning output directory: ", output_base)
    success <- unlink(output_base, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
    if (success == 0) {
      message("Successfully removed: ", output_base)
    } else {
      warning("Failed to remove: ", output_base)
    }
}

# Recreate the output folder cleanly
dir.create(output_base, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
message("Output directory created: ", output_base)

# Loop over each Sample_Type
for (lifestage in lifestage_list) {
  message("Processing: ", lifestage)

  # Subset metadata
  meta_sub <- subset(meta, Lifestage == lifestage)

  # Convert fixed effects to factors
  meta_sub$Site <- factor(meta_sub$Site)
  meta_sub$Location <- factor(meta_sub$Location)

  # Skip if too few samples
  if (nrow(meta_sub) < 10) {
    message("  Skipping (too few samples)")
    next
  }

  # Subset OTU
  otu_sub <- otu_filtered[rownames(meta_sub), , drop = FALSE]

  # Drop features with no variance
  otu_sub <- otu_sub[, apply(otu_sub, 2, var) > 0]

  # Match sample order
  meta_sub <- meta_sub[order(rownames(meta_sub)), ]
  otu_sub <- otu_sub[order(rownames(otu_sub)), ]
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(meta_sub), rownames(otu_sub)))

  # Define output directory for Sample_Type
  output_dir_st <- file.path(output_base, paste0("lifestage_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", lifestage)))
  dir.create(output_dir_st, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  formula_to_use <- "~ Location + read_depth + (1 | Site)"

  
  # Run MaAsLin3
  fit_data <- maaslin3(
  input_data = otu_sub,
  input_metadata = meta_sub,
  output = output_dir_st,
  formula = formula_to_use,
  normalization = 'TSS',
  transform = 'LOG',
  augment = TRUE,
  max_significance = 0.1,
  verbosity = "DEBUG",
  small_random_effects = TRUE,
  standardize = T
)
}
```

## MaAsLin3 by sample type

\~ Location + read_depth + (1 \| Site)

small_random_effects=TRUE

```{r maaslin3-by-sample-type}
# Customize this as needed
sample_type_list <- unique(meta$Sample_Type)

output_base <- file.path(output_dir, "MaAsLin3_by_Sample_Type")

# Remove the existing output folder if it exists
if (dir.exists(output_base)) {
    message("Cleaning output directory: ", output_base)
    success <- unlink(output_base, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
    if (success == 0) {
      message("Successfully removed: ", output_base)
    } else {
      warning("Failed to remove: ", output_base)
    }
}

# Recreate the output folder cleanly
dir.create(output_base, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
message("Output directory created: ", output_base)

# Loop over each Sample_Type
for (sample_type in sample_type_list) {
  message("Processing: ", sample_type)

  # Subset metadata
  meta_sub <- subset(meta, Sample_Type == sample_type)
# Drop NAs in Taxa
  meta_sub <- meta_sub[!is.na(meta_sub$Taxa), ]

  # Convert fixed effects to factors
  meta_sub$Site <- factor(meta_sub$Site)
  meta_sub$Location <- factor(meta_sub$Location)
  

  # Subset OTU
  otu_sub <- otu_filtered[rownames(meta_sub), , drop = FALSE]

  # Drop features with no variance
  otu_sub <- otu_sub[, apply(otu_sub, 2, var) > 0]

  # Match sample order
  meta_sub <- meta_sub[order(rownames(meta_sub)), ]
  otu_sub <- otu_sub[order(rownames(otu_sub)), ]
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(meta_sub), rownames(otu_sub)))

  # Define output directory for Sample_Type
  output_dir_st <- file.path(output_base, paste0("Sample_Type_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", sample_type)))
  dir.create(output_dir_st, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # Run MaAsLin3
  fit_data <- maaslin3(
    input_data = otu_sub,
    input_metadata = meta_sub,
    output = output_dir_st,
    formula = "~ Location + read_depth + (1 | Site)",
                    normalization = 'TSS',
                    transform = 'LOG',
                    augment = TRUE, #to avoid linear separability in the logistic regressions, almost always recommended
                    standardize = TRUE, #standardize numeric/continous variables in meta
                    max_significance = 0.1,
    small_random_effects=TRUE,
    verbosity="ERROR" #only show errors
     )
}
```

## Summary

```{r extract-significant-res}
# Automatically find all MaAsLin3 output directories
maaslin_output_dirs <- list.dirs(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
maaslin_output_dirs <- maaslin_output_dirs[grepl("MaAsLin3", maaslin_output_dirs)]

# === USER PARAMETERS ===
qval_cutoff <- 0.05

# === Collect all MaAsLin3 result folders automatically ===
maaslin_output_dirs <- list.dirs(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
maaslin_output_dirs <- maaslin_output_dirs[grepl("MaAsLin3", maaslin_output_dirs)]

# === Initialize collector ===
all_sig_results <- list()

# === Extraction loop ===
for (dir in maaslin_output_dirs) {
  message("Scanning in: ", dir)

  result_files <- list.files(
    path = dir,
    pattern = "all_results.tsv",
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  for (file in result_files) {
    message("Reading: ", file)

    df <- tryCatch(
      readr::read_tsv(file, show_col_types = FALSE),
      error = function(e) {
        message("Error reading file: ", file)
        return(NULL)
      }
    )
    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) next

    # Annotate with context (folder above the file)
    context <- basename(dirname(file))

    # Filter by significance
    df_sig <- df %>%
      filter(qval_joint <= qval_cutoff) %>%
      mutate(
        Source_Context = context,
        Source_File = basename(file),
        Source_Path = file
      )

    if (nrow(df_sig) > 0) {
      all_sig_results[[length(all_sig_results) + 1]] <- df_sig
    }
  }
}


if (length(all_sig_results) > 0) {
  combined_sig_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_sig_results) %>%
    select(
      feature, metadata, value, name, coef,
      stderr, pval_joint, qval_joint,
      model, N, N_not_zero,
      Source_Context, Source_File, Source_Path
    ) %>%
    arrange(qval_joint)

  # Export 
  output_file <- file.path(output_dir, "MaAsLin3_All_Significant_Results.csv")
  readr::write_csv(combined_sig_df, output_file)
  message("Combined significant results saved to: ", output_file)

} else {
  message("No significant results found at qval_joint <= ", qval_cutoff)
  combined_sig_df <- tibble::tibble()
}

#Plot
if (nrow(combined_sig_df) > 0) {

  meta_vars_to_plot <- c("Location", "Lifestage", "Sample_Type")
  top_n <- 20  #max number plotted
  plot_df <- combined_sig_df %>%
    filter(metadata %in% meta_vars_to_plot[meta_vars_to_plot %in% unique(combined_sig_df$metadata)]) %>%
    mutate(
      feature_clean = stringr::str_replace_all(feature, "_", " "),
      Context = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("^Taxon_", Source_Context) ~ stringr::str_replace(Source_Context, "Taxon_", "Taxon: "),
        grepl("^Sample_Type_", Source_Context) ~ stringr::str_replace(Source_Context, "Sample_Type_", "Sample Type: "),
        grepl("^lifestage_", Source_Context) ~ stringr::str_replace(Source_Context, "lifestage_", "Lifestage: "),
        TRUE ~ Source_Context
      ),
      Context = factor(Context),
      Sign = if_else(coef >= 0, "Positive", "Negative")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(coef))

  plot_by_metadata <- function(data, meta_value) {
    df_sub <- data %>%
      filter(metadata == meta_value) %>%
      group_by(Context) %>%
      slice_min(order_by = qval_joint, n = top_n, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup()

    if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) {
      message("No data available to plot for metadata: ", meta_value)
      return(
        ggplot() +
          theme_void() +
          labs(title = paste("No significant associations for", meta_value))
      )
    }

    message("Generating plot for metadata: ", meta_value)

    ggplot(df_sub, aes(
      x = coef,
      y = forcats::fct_reorder(feature_clean, coef),
      color = model,
      shape = model
    )) +
      geom_point(size = 5, alpha = 0.9) +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = coef - stderr, xmax = coef + stderr), height = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
      facet_grid(rows = vars(Context), scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("abundance" = "#1b9e77", "prevalence" = "#d95f02"), na.translate = FALSE) +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c("abundance" = 16, "prevalence" = 17)) +
      labs(
        x = "Effect Size (Coefficient ± SE)",
        y = "Feature",
        color = "Model",
        shape = "Model",
        title = paste("Top", top_n, "Significant Associations by", meta_value)
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 24) +
      theme(
        strip.text = element_text(size = 26, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 22),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold")
      )
  }

  n_facets <- length(unique(plot_df$Context))
  facet_height <- 3.5
  plot_height <- max(12, n_facets * facet_height)

  for (meta_value in meta_vars_to_plot) {
    if (!(meta_value %in% unique(plot_df$metadata))) {
      message("Skipping: ", meta_value, " (not in results)")
      next
    }

    plot_obj <- plot_by_metadata(plot_df, meta_value)
    print(plot_obj)

    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0("MaAsLin3_", meta_value, "_Significant_Associations.png")),
      plot = plot_obj,
      width = 18,   
      height = plot_height,
      dpi = 450
    )
    message("Saved plot for metadata: ", meta_value, " at ", file.path(output_dir, paste0("MaAsLin3_", meta_value, "_Significant_Associations.png")))
  }
}


combined_sig_df
```

### Check taxa abundances

```{r eval= F}
# Loop over each metadata variable to plot taxa abundances for significant taxa
for (meta_var in meta_vars_to_plot) {
  
  message("Plotting taxa for metadata variable: ", meta_var)
  
  # Filter significant taxa for this metadata variable and qval < 0.05
  sig_taxa <- combined_sig_df %>%
    filter(metadata == meta_var, qval_joint <= 0.05) %>%
    pull(feature) %>%
    unique()
  
  # Check if any taxa present
  if (length(sig_taxa) == 0) {
    message("No significant taxa for ", meta_var)
    next
  }
  
  # Sometimes feature names have underscores vs spaces, try to clean them to match OTU colnames
  # If  otu colnames have underscores, ensure matching format:
  sig_taxa_clean <- sig_taxa %>% 
    str_replace_all(" ", "_")
  
  # Keep only taxa present in OTU table
  sig_taxa_clean <- sig_taxa_clean[sig_taxa_clean %in% colnames(otu_filtered)]
  
  if (length(sig_taxa_clean) == 0) {
    message("No matching taxa found in OTU table for ", meta_var)
    next
  }
  
  # Subset abundance data for these taxa
  abund_sub <- otu_filtered[, sig_taxa_clean, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Add sample IDs to abund_sub
  abund_sub$SampleID <- rownames(abund_sub)
  
  # Convert to long format for ggplot
  abund_long <- abund_sub %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -SampleID, names_to = "Taxon", values_to = "Abundance")
  
  # Join with metadata
  abund_long <- abund_long %>%
    left_join(meta %>% mutate(SampleID = rownames(meta)), by = "SampleID")
  
  # plot abundance by meta_var groups, faceted by Taxon
  # Replace meta_var with actual column in metadata
  if (!(meta_var %in% colnames(meta))) {
    message("Metadata variable ", meta_var, " not found in sample metadata, skipping.")
    next
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(abund_long, aes_string(x = meta_var, y = "Abundance", fill = meta_var)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = "mean", position = position_dodge()) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, size = 1, color = "black") +
    facet_wrap(~ Taxon, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Abundance of significant taxa by", meta_var),
      y = "Mean abundance (TSS normalized counts)",
      x = meta_var
    ) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(title = meta_var))
  
  print(p)
  
  # save
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0("MaAsLin3_", meta_var, "_Significant_Taxa_Abundance.png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 14,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```

#### Check specific taxa (lifestage comparison)

```{r, eval=FALSE}
#Corynebacterium_glyciniphilum
#Alcaligenes_faecalis
#Runella_limosa
#Hydrogenophaga_taeniospiralis
#Clostridium_sensu_stricto_13_estertheticum
#Clostridium_sensu_stricto_5_cavendishii
#Rhodobacter_blasticus

# Define species of interest
sp_taxon <- "Rhodobacter_blasticus"

# Check presence in your OTU table
col_to_use <- grep(sp_taxon, colnames(otu), value = TRUE)
if (length(col_to_use) == 0) {
  stop("No column found for ", sp_taxon, " in your OTU table.")
}

# Calculate relative abundance
otu_rel <- otu / rowSums(otu)
otu_rel[is.na(otu_rel)] <- 0

# Create plotting dataframe
plot_df <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    SampleID = rownames(meta),
    Abundance = otu_rel[, col_to_use]
  )

# Replace zeroes with small value for log plotting
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(Abundance_log = ifelse(Abundance == 0, 1e-5, Abundance))


# Calculate summary table
summary_df <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(Lifestage, Location, Site) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abundance = mean(Abundance),
    se_abundance = sd(Abundance) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot without facet, adding Site as part of x-axis grouping
ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = interaction(Lifestage, Site, sep = " - "), y = mean_abundance, fill = Location)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_abundance - se_abundance, ymax = mean_abundance + se_abundance),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.01), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(sp_taxon, " Mean Relative Abundance"),
    y = "Relative Abundance (%)",
    x = "Lifestage - Site"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )



# Faceted barplot by Site
ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = Lifestage, y = mean_abundance, fill = Location)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = pmax(0, mean_abundance - se_abundance), ymax = mean_abundance + se_abundance),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Site) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.01), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(sp_taxon, " Mean Relative Abundance by Site"),
    y = "Relative Abundance (%)",
    x = "Lifestage"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Create summary ignoring Site
summary_df_lifestage <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(Lifestage, Location) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abundance = mean(Abundance),
    se_abundance = sd(Abundance) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Barplot without Site, comparing Lifestage
ggplot(summary_df_lifestage, aes(x = Lifestage, y = mean_abundance, fill = Location)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = pmax(0, mean_abundance - se_abundance), ymax = mean_abundance + se_abundance),

    width = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.01), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +

  labs(
    title = paste0(sp_taxon, " Mean Relative Abundance by Lifestage"),

    x = "Lifestage"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),

  )
```
